question: Who has been appointed as India’s Ambassador to Slovak Republic in October 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __Apoorva Srivastava__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Apoorva Srivastava**, a diplomat in the** Indian Foreign Service**, has been appointed as **India's next Ambassador to the Slovak Republic**.
 
• She is currently serving as Consul-General at the Consulate of India in Toro
